axes.blender: armature space, mm, right-handed, Z up
axes.unreal: component space, cm, left-handed (Blender y flipped), Z up

bipod_leg_l.motion: rotate about Y (0 folded forward, +90 deployed down)

bone_notes.cheek_riser: parent body (gunlib proposal P1: the standard lists stock only; SR01 has no stock bone and never a dummy)
bone_notes.bipod_leg_l: rotate +0..90 about the pin axis (0, cos 12, +sin 12) through the head (Y rolled +12 deg about X): the deployed leg leans 12 deg out to the left
bone_notes.bipod_leg_r: rotate +0..90 about the pin axis (0, cos 12, -sin 12) (Y rolled -12 deg about X): the deployed leg leans 12 deg out to the right
bone_notes.bipod_leg_l_ext: translate +X in the leg's rest frame 0..76 (detents every 19)
bone_notes.bipod_leg_r_ext: translate +X in the leg's rest frame 0..76 (detents every 19)
bone_notes.bolt: rotate about X 0..-60, then translate -X 0..88 (slide only at -60)

lod_note: import LOD1-3 with SkeletalMeshEditorSubsystem.import_lod (same skeleton, same root; no bones removed). The sizes are the LOD-pop gate's switch distances (both bipod poses) at the SK's engine radius (bind box + bounds extension). First-person components force LOD0 (ForcedLodModel = 1)
notifies_note: FBX carries no notifies: the Unreal harness adds them at these frames (U9). ReloadEmpty starts with the bolt open and BipodStow starts deployed at ext 38 (starts_at_rest false); BipodDeploy ends deployed (ends_at_rest false). Fire, BoltCycle and ReloadEmpty hold the safety at FIRE

import.bone_compression_why: rigid parts: ACL cracked rigid parts by ~1.1 mm on the fan (gun study 4.10.9); U9 gates <= 0.1 mm

bounds_extension_cm.why: LOD0-3 posed at every frame of every clip and at the extreme poses (bipod folded / deployed x ext 0 / 76 x cant -15 / 0 / +15, riser -12.9 / +12, bolt open / back) vs LOD0's bind AABB (Unreal's stored bounds), per axis (+1 mm where it grows; Unreal axes: y flipped): the mesh's Positive / Negative Bounds Extension. The magazine and the scope are their own components

physics_proxies.how: import the proxy onto SK_SR01_Skeleton with Create Physics Asset ON (one 250 mm cube on 'body'), rewrite the body from physics_bodies, rename it PHYS_SR01, assign it to SK_SR01, delete the proxy mesh

elements.covers: action: chassis centre, receiver, rail, bolt + handle, safety
bipod (folded): swivel, knob, legs, extensions, feet
barrel + muzzle device ahead of the forend

bounds envelope: the mesh's extended bounds (bind AABB + bounds extension: every clip frame + bipod deployed / extended / canted, bolt open / back, riser range); no collision, no mass (the component's physics-route bounds, SMG W5 U7)

physics_bodies.role: ONE rigid body on 'body' (every other bone is its child): Kinematic while held, simulated when dropped with the bipod folded (BipodStow or snap the legs to 0 first); the last box is the bounds envelope (no collision, no mass) so the component's bounds hold every pose; the seated magazine and the scope are their own components with collision off while attached

sockets.name: SupportHand
sockets.use: forend belly behind the bipod clamp

sockets.name: SupportHandBipod
sockets.use: off hand under the butt when prone (rear-bag grip)

sockets.name: ShellEject
sockets.use: port centre; +X = throw (right, up, slightly back)

sockets.name: Rail_Top
sockets.use: centre of slot 0 of 15; slot k = +k x 10.01

sockets.name: SlingFront
sockets.use: sling hooks to the bipod clamp's front

sockets.name: SlingRear
sockets.use: the QD-cup recess GL draws on the butt's left

sockets.name: CenterOfMass
sockets.state: provisional (computed at W1 from part volumes, scaled to 5.9 kg)

sockets.name: BoltHandle
sockets.use: knob centre (hand target for the bolt cycle)

sockets.name: BipodFoot_L
sockets.use: foot end-face centre: the ground contact when deployed

magazine.attach: zero relative transform (SnapToTarget) on the Mag socket; straight reload path MagInsertStart -> (lerp along -Z, rotation constant) -> Mag

M_SR01_Chassis.user_control: Colour on the OD paint only (Masks A = 1 there; rubber, polymer and anodize at A 0)

frames.M: +X muzzle, +Z up, +Y gun left; X 0 butt-pad rear, Z 0 bore
frames.B: B = M - Grip (mm); Unreal cm = (Bx, -By, Bz) / 10

gun.action: bolt action: 3-lug bolt, rotate -60 deg about the bore then slide 88 mm (A_SR01_BoltCycle; the game chains Fire -> BoltCycle or skips it)

bipod.legs: independent, 0 (folded forward) .. +90 (deployed), detents 0 / 90; each leg swings about its pin rolled 12 deg about the leg axis (outboard down): deployed legs lean 12 deg out
bipod.prone: set both legs to 90 and the extension so BipodFoot_L / _R reach the ground (a scalar per leg); cant = bipod bone about X; drop the gun with the legs folded
bipod.physics: PHYS_SR01 uses the folded pose; deployed legs are kinematic while held

scope.note: attach the scope's Mount to Rail_Top + 2 slots (X +20.02 mm); the gun has no Sight socket (no iron sights): the scope's Sight / EyePoint are the aim sockets

A.what: rear sight leaf / aperture, optic eyepiece, front post and hood (ADS 55 deg at 0.20-0.25 m)

B.what: rear receiver, dust cover, selector, charging handle, grip top, comb

C.what: mag, magwell, trigger guard, handguards, front receiver

D.what: gas block, front sight base, barrel, brake

E.what: hidden: undersides, insides, contact faces (reload-visible insides at the low end)

gun.first_person: FP_Weapon + TP_Weapon (SK_SR01), FP_Mag + TP_Mag (SM_SR01_Mag on Mag), FP_Scope + TP_Scope (SM_Att_Scope_LongRange on Rail_Top + 2 slots); every FP component FirstPersonPrimitiveType = FirstPerson and ForcedLodModel = 1
